headline: ServeSync on your home screen: flexible, interactive Android widgets.
highlights: Add widgets for your next assignment, schedule, approved setlist, church announcements, pending responses, and quick shortcuts.
Choose Minimal, Church-branded, or Bold designs, light/dark/system themes, and four accent colors for each widget.
Resize from narrow 1×2 and compact 2×1 arrangements to larger agendas, subject to your phone's home-screen grid.
Tap to open the relevant screen or use paging arrows with optional short transitions. Open ServeSync to refresh saved widget information.
